name: a2a_wkv_b2 (4-chip ring, matmul first)
math: out_r[h, 160*j + t, v] = sum_l attn_j[24*r + h, t, l] * W[24*r + h, l, v]

placement.attn: chip j: its own [96,160,512] in DRAM, row-major pages of 1024 B
placement.W: every chip: all 96 heads in DRAM (replicated), bfp8_b tiles of 1088 B
placement.out: chip r: heads 24r..24r+23 of every ring member's tokens, L1 interleaved bfp8_b tiles

reference.source: pipeline_spec.json spec; SOL 43,776 ns from feature_spec.py

must_about: ring total of link byte-hops (graph holds all 4 chips): per chip 2 neighbour chunks x 522,240 B x 1 hop + the opposite chip's 522,240 B x 2 hops = 2,088,960; DRAM bytes (22,413,312 per chip) are in the rdW/rdA tasks
